The rule

Project 2 · Lesson 3.1
How it works

Delete files and new files

1
DELETE
writes a delete file: the row positions to skip
ducklake-…5d4e.parquet7,176 rows, untouched
ducklake-…-delete.parquetpositions to skip
2
UPDATE = DELETE + INSERT
the old rows are skipped, the new rows go into a new file
ducklake-…5f9e.parquet72 updated rows
3
SET (write_deletion_vectors = true)
a more compact format, per table; maintenance rewrites files later (4.4)

Recap

What to remember

1
Parquet files are never edited.
2
A delete adds a delete file.
3
An update is a delete plus an insert.
